proposal.summary: WinGate v9.4.1.5998 installation directory has insecure permissions that grant 'Authenticated Users' full control on WinGate.exe, allowing a local authenticated user to replace the executable and achieve code execution as SYSTEM after a service restart or reboot.
proposal.cwe_quote:
WinGate has insecure permissions for the installation directory, which allows local
users ability to gain privileges by replacing an executable file with a Trojan horse.

PR.quote: Logon as standard user replace WinGate.exe with a trojan executable, wait for restart or reboot the system, your code runs as SYSTEM.

UI.quote: Logon as standard user replace WinGate.exe with a trojan executable, wait for restart or reboot the system, your code runs as SYSTEM.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce locally: confirm the directory ACLs shown, verify an authenticated non-admin can replace WinGate.exe and that the service restart or system reboot executes the replaced binary. If confirmed, recommend vendor to restrict installation directory permissions (remove write/modify for Authenticated Users) and provide a patched installer or guidance to set correct ACLs.

evidence_quotes.quote:

evidence_quotes.claim: Directory ACL output showing Authenticated Users:F
evidence_quotes.quote:

C:\Program Files\WinGate\WinGate.exe NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(ID)F
                                     NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(ID)F
                                     BUILTIN\Administrators:(ID)F
                                     BUILTIN\Users:(ID)R
                                     APPLICATION PACKAGE AUTHORITY\ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES:(ID)R
                                     APPLICATION PACKAGE AUTHORITY\ALL RESTRICTED APPLICATION PACKAGES:(ID)R
Logon as standard user replace WinGate.exe with a trojan executable, wait for restart or reboot the system, your code runs as SYSTEM.
